clips.title: The story
paras: In Durotar, Taming the Beast sends young hunters to the coast for their second trial. Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, directs aspiring orc and troll hunters to pacify a surf crawler near the Echo Isles and extend their bond to coastal wildlife.

After mastering a dire mottled boar, you turn your attention to the sea at Thotar's direction. Durotar's harsh shores are jagged, and shallow reefs teem with armored crustaceans. A surf crawler resists intrusion into its coastal domain, so taming one calls for patience and fortitude.

Thotar teaches that a bound beast must become an extension of a hunter's strength. Subduing a surf crawler with the taming rod teaches you to command creatures of different temperaments in different surroundings. It proves you are ready for permanent companions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The advantage a pet affords you against your rivals is duly noted, friend. When you gain control over another creature, you are adding to your own strength. Your pet must become an extension of yourself.

The next task requires you to turn from the land; you will find the next creature in the waters off the coast. Across from Sen'jin Village, near the Echo Isles. Look for a spirited crab called the surf crawler. Use the taming rod to tame it, then practice your skills.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You need to practice in order to gain the skills you need to effectively control your pet. Have you tamed a surf crawler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are a swift learner, friend. You have done well.
